- The collector install script downloads the pinned `otelcol-contrib` `.deb` from imbue's artifact mirror (`https://apt.imbuepackages.com/artifacts/otelcol-contrib/<version>/...`) instead of GitHub, so a pruned or unreachable upstream release cannot break a box prep or a relay/instance provision. The sha256 verification is unchanged; `OTELCOL_DEB_SHA256_BY_GOARCH` and the deb URL helpers are public for the mirror's artifact manifest.
